senses.gloss:
प्रम् प्रम्, ind. (fr. rt. 1. प्रा), in गोष्पद-
प्रम्, sufficiently to fill the print of a cow's foot; (also
गोष्पद-पूरम्, Scholiast on Pāṇ. III. 4, 32.)

प्रमंहिष्ठीय प्रमंहिष्ठीय, अम्, n., Ved.,
N. of a Sāman (so called from its beginning with
the words प्र मंहिष्ठाय).

प्रमगन्द प्र-मगन्द, अस्, m., Ved. the son
of a usurer, (according to Sāy. मगन्द = कुसीदिन्,
तद्-अपत्यम् प्र-मगन्दः); N. of a king.
प्रमग्न प्र-मग्न. See प्र-मज्ज् below.

प्र-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, immersed, dipped,
drowned. See Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 29.

प्रमङ्गन प्र-मङ्गन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. मङ्ग्
with प्र), going, proceeding.

प्र-मङ्गनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone or pro-
ceeded.
प्र-मङ्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, proceeded.

प्रमज्ज् प्र-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, -मङ्क्-
तुम्, Ved. to immerse one's self in, dip into.

प्रमणस् प्र-मणस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, careful, soli-
citous, attentive (Ved.); kind, amiable (Ved.); good-
natured, joyful, cheerful; [cf. प्र-मनस्.]

प्रमण्डल प्र-मण्डल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
the felly of a wheel (?).
प्रमत प्र-मत, &c. See प्र-मन्, p. 637.

प्र-मत, अस्, आ, अम्, thought out, excogitated;
wise.
प्रमत्त प्र-मत्त, &c. See 1. प्र-मद्, col. 3.

प्र-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, excited, wanton, lascivious,
rutting; drunken, intoxicated; mad, insane; careless,
regardless, heedless, inattentive, negligent; unmindful
of duty; blundering, a blunderer.
—प्रमत्त-गीत,
अस्, आ, अम्, inattentively or carelessly sung.
—प्र-
मत्त-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, careless-minded, heedless,
negligent.
—प्रमत्त-ता, f. inattentiveness, inat-
tention, sleepiness, mental inactivity.
—१. प्रमत्त-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, inattentive, careless.
—२. प्रमत्त-
वत्, ind. as if drunk, like one intoxicated.

प्रमथ् प्र-मथ् or प्र-मन्थ्, cl. 1. 9. P.
-मथति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति, -मन्थितुम्, to
stir about violently, agitate, churn; to trample down,
strike down, bruise; to rob (Ved.); to assault
violently, handle roughly, harass, annoy; to destroy,
lay waste, devastate; to tear away, tear off, tear out,
cut out: Caus. -माथयति, -यितुम्, to assault vio-
lently, handle roughly, harass, annoy.

प्र-मथ, अस्, m. ‘destroyer, tormentor,’ N. of
a class of fiends attending on Śiva; N. of one of
the hundred sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; a horse; (आ), f.
the plant Terminalia Chebula or Citrina (= हरी-
तकी); N. of the wife of Kṣupa and mother of
Vīra; pain, affliction (?).
—प्रमथ-नाथ, अस्,
or प्रमथ-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the Pramathas,’
an epithet of Śiva.
—प्रमथाधिप (˚थ-अध्˚),
अस्, m. ‘ruler of the Pramathas,’ an epithet of Śiva;
of Gaṇeśa.
—प्रमथालय (˚थ-आल्˚), अस्, m.
‘abode of torment (?) ,’ hell.
प्रमाथ प्र-माथ, &c. See p. 636, col. 3.

प्र-मथन, अस्, ई, अम्, harassing, tormenting,
torturing, paining, hurting, injuring; (अस्), m., N.
of a magical formula pronounced over weapons; N.
of a Dānava; (अम्), n. hurting, paining, distressing,
injuring; killing, slaughter; agitating, churning.

प्र-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, well churned; trampled
on, cut down, killed; pained, distressed; (अम्), n. but-
termilk without water.
—प्रमथित-पुरःसर, अस्,
आ, अम्, having the leader killed, whose leader is slain.

प्र-माथित, अस्, आ, अम्, assaulted violently,
roughly handled; violated, ravished, forcibly carried
off.

प्र-मथ्य, ind. having conquered or oppressed;
having used violence, violently, forcibly.
प्र-मथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being churned.

प्र-मन्थ, अस्, m., Ved. a stick used for rubbing
wood to produce fire by friction.

प्र-मन्थु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Vīra-vrata
and younger brother of Manthu.

प्र-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, stirring about, setting in
motion, agitating; striking off, striking down, used
for striking or knocking down; tearing, rending;
breaking, cutting; disquieting, troubling, harassing,
annoying, afflicting, torturing [cf. चित्त-प्˚]; killing,
destroying, a destroyer; (ई), m., N. of a son of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of a Rākṣasa; of a monkey; N.
of the thirteenth (of forty-seventh) year of a sixty
years' cycle of Jupiter; (इनी), f., N. of an Apsaras.

प्रमद् 1. प्र-मद्, cl. 4. P. -माद्यति, -मदि-
तुम्, to enjoy one's self, be joyous, sport, play,
gambol (Ved.); to be regardless of, be indifferent
to (with abl.); to pay no attention to, give no heed
to, neglect, be heedless about (with loc.); to neglect
duty for, idle away time in (with loc.); Caus. P. A.
-मादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to make light of, ridicule;
(A.) to enjoy, indulge in (Ved.).
2. प्र-मद्, त्, f., Ved. lust, desire.

प्र-मद, अस्, m. joy, joyousness, joyfulness,
pleasure, delight, elation, rapture; the Datura tree or
thorn-apple, D. Metel [cf. उन्-मत्त]; N. of a
Dānava; of a son of Vasiṣṭha and one of the seven
sages under Manu Uttama, = गुल्फ?; (आ), f. a
young and wanton woman, a handsome or beautiful
woman, a woman in general; the sign of the zodiac
Virgo; N. of a metre of 29 + 27 syllables; of another
metre, four times ˘˘˘˘¯˘¯˘˘˘¯˘˘¯; (अस्,
आ, अम्), wanton, dissolute; mad, intoxicated (literally
or metaphorically); impassioned; violent; careless.
—प्रमद-कण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—प्र-
मद-कानन or प्रमदा-कानन, अम्, n. a
royal garden or pleasure-ground attached to the
gynæceum.
—प्रमद-रोप्य, अम्, n., N. of a
city in the Dekhan; [cf. महिला-रोप्य, मिहिला-
रोप्य.]
—प्रमद-वन = प्रमद-कानन.
—प्रमदा-जन, अस्, m. womankind, the female
sex.
—प्रमदानन (˚दा-आन्˚), अम्, n. a kind of
metre, four times ˘˘¯˘¯˘˘¯˘¯˘˘¯˘¯˘˘¯˘¯.
—प्रमदा-वन, अम्, n. a royal garden or
pleasure-ground for the wives of a prince (attached
especially to the private apartments of the palace).

प्र-माद, अस्, m. drunkenness, intoxication; mad-
ness, insanity, distraction, confusion; negligence, inat-
tention, carelessness; inadvertence, error, inaccuracy,
a blunder, mistake; a particular high number.
—प्र-
माद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, drunken, intoxicated; mad,
insane; incautious, careless, heedless, inconsiderate.

प्रमाद प्र-माद, &c. See under 1. प्र-
मद्, p. 636, col. 3.

प्र-मदक, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolute, licentious,
sensual.
प्र-मदन, अम्, n. amorous desire.

प्रमदाय, Nom. P. प्रमदायति, -यितुम्,
to behave like a wanton woman.

प्र-मदितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be neglected or dis-
regarded, to be treated with inattention (with abl.).

प्र-मद्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, inattentive, careless; (आ),
f., N. of the wife of Ruru and mother of Śunaka.

प्रमादिका, f. an imprudent or careless woman;
a deflowered girl.

प्रामादिक प्रामादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
माद), arising from carelessness or negligence,
blundering, faulty, erroneous, incorrect, wrong; प्रा-
मादिकः पाठः, a wrong reading.
—प्रामादिक-
त्व, अम्, n. erroneousness, incorrectness.

प्र-मादित, अस्, आ, अम्, made light of, ridiculed,
mocked.

प्रमादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, drunken, intoxicated; in-
sane; negligent, inattentive, inadvertent, careless,
heedless, incautious, indifferent; (ई), m., N. of the
forty-seventh (or twenty-first) year of a sixty years’
cycle of Jupiter.

प्रमाद्य (?), अम्, n. insanity, carelessness.
—प्रमाद्य-तस् (?), ind. from carelessness.

प्रामाद्य, अस्, m. a species of plant, Gendarussa
(= अटरूष) Adhadota or Vulgaris; (अम्), n.
madness, frenzy, fury; intoxication.

प्रमन् प्र-मन्, cl. 8. A. -मनुते, &c.,
Ved. to think upon, excogitate.
प्रमतक, अस्, m., N. of an ancient sage.

प्र-मति, इस्, f. care, providence, protection (Ved.,
cf. अदब्ध-व्रत-प्˚, इन्द्र-प्˚); one who pro-
vides for, a protector (Ved.); (इस्), m., N. of an
ancient sage; of a son of Cyavana and father of
Ruru; of a prince (son of Janam-ejaya); of a son
of Prāṃśu.

प्रामति प्रामति, इस्, m., N. of one of the
seven sages in the tenth Manv-antara; (also read
प्राप्तति; cf. प्र-मति.)

प्र-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. प्र + मनस्), cheer-
ful-minded, good-tempered, in good spirits, happy,
delighted; [cf. प्र-मणस्.]

प्र-मन्त्र, अस्, or अम्, m. or n.? (fr. प्र +
मन्त्र), a particular high number; [cf. प्र-मात्र.]
प्रमन्थ् प्र-मन्थ्. See प्र-मथ्, p. 636.

प्रमन्द प्र-मन्द, अस्, m. or प्र-मन्दनी,
f., Ved. a species of fragrant plant.

प्रमन्यु प्र-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, incensed or
enraged against (with loc.); distressed, sorrowful.
प्रमय प्र-मय, &c. See p. 638, col. 1.

प्र-मय, अस्, m. ruin, downfall, fall, death;
killing, slaughter.
प्रमाय प्र-माय. See under प्र-मि below.
प्र-माय, ind. having perceived or observed.

प्रमर प्र-मर, &c. See under प्र-मृ,
p. 638, col. 2.
प्र-मर, अस्, m., Ved. death, dying.
प्रमार प्र-मार. See प्र-मृ, p. 638.
प्र-मार, अस्, m., Ved. = प्र-मरण.

प्रमर्दक प्र-मर्दक, प्र-मर्दन, &c.
See प्र-मृद्, p. 638, col. 3.

प्र-मर्दक, अस्, आ, अम्, crushing down, crush-
ing, destroying; N. of a demon.

प्रमहस् प्र-महस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. of great
splendor (said of Mitra-Varuṇa, Sāy. = प्रकृष्ट-
तेजस्क).

प्रमा 1. प्र-मा, cl. 2. P., 3. 4. A. -माति,
-मिमीते, -मायते, -मातुम्, to measure; to form,
frame, make; to arrange, set in order; to form a
correct notion of (anything), understand; to con-
jecture: Caus. -मापयति, -यितुम्, to cause correct
knowledge, afford proof or authority, give proof.

2. प्र-मा, f. basis, foundation (Ved.); a measure
(Ved.); true perception, correct notion, accurate
conception, true and certain knowledge, knowledge
exempt from all error; consciousness, perception; a
kind of metre.
—प्रमा-त्व, अम्, n. accuracy of
perception, trueness or correctness of knowledge.

1. प्र-मा; the प्र of the Nāgarī type has
broken off in the printing of part of the impression.

प्र-माण, अम्, n. measure, scale, standard;
measure in general (whether of weight, length, or
capacity); magnitude, extent, circumference, length,
duration (of time); weight, quantity; rule, sanction,
ground of assurance, standard, authority, judgment,
warrant; a decider, one whose advice or decision is
an authority (e. g. प्रमाणम् भवती, your lady-
ship is the warrant or you must judge; प्रमाणम्
भवन्तः, your honours are the authority, i. e.
it is yours to decide or I abide by your advice, cf.
also स्त्री-प्˚; in this sense प्रमाण sometimes
follows the number and gender of the word with
which it is placed in apposition, e. g. यदि वेदाः
प्रमाणास् ते, if the Vedas be thy authorities; स्त्री
प्रमाणी येषाम्, they whose authority is a woman);
a means of acquiring प्रमा or certain knowledge,
source of knowledge, means of proof, proof, (the
Vedānta admits six Pramāṇas, viz. 1. प्रत्यक्ष,
perception by the senses; 2. अनुमान, inference;
3. उपमान, analogy or comparison; 4. शब्द or
आप्त-वचन, verbal authority, trustworthy testi-
mony, especially of an inspired person, revelation;
5. अन्-उपलब्धि or अभाव-प्रत्यक्ष, non-
[]
perception or negative proof; 6. अर्थापत्ति, in-
ference from circumstances. The Nyāya admits
only four, excluding the last two. The Sāṅkhya
only three, viz. Pratyakṣa, Anumāna, and Śabda,
excluding the third or Upamāna as well as the fifth
and sixth: besides the Pramāṇas of the three orthodox
schools, with their branches, other schools increase
the number to nine by adding 1. सम्भव, equi-
valence; 2. ऐतिह्य, tradition or fallible testimony;
3. चेष्टा, gesture); testimony, evidence; a scrip-
ture, a work of sacred authority; a speaker of the
truth; a correct notion, right conception; cause,
motive; a sense of security, freedom from appre-
hension; the prosodial length of a vowel; physical
power or strength; the first term in a rule of three
sum; principal, capital; oneness, unity; constant,
eternal; a title of Viṣṇu; (अस्), m. rule, standard,
authority; N. of a large fig-tree on the bank of
the Ganges (Mahā-bh. Vana-p. 41); (ई), f. rule,
standard, authority; a kind of metre.
—प्रमाण-
कोटी, f., N. of a particular spot or of a Tīrtha near
the above fig-tree on the bank of the Ganges; [cf.
प्र-माण.]
—प्रमाण-ज्ञ, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva.
—प्रमाण-तस्, ind. agreeably to measure or
weight, with respect to measure, &c.; according to
proof or authority.
—प्रमाण-ता, f. or प्रमाण-
त्व, अम्, n. authority, warranty.
—प्रमाण-
दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, recognised by authority, en-
joined by good authorities.
—प्रमाण-पत्त्र,
अम्, n. a written warrant.
—प्रमाण-पुरुष,
अस्, m. ‘a man who is an authority,’ an umpire,
arbitrator, judge.
—प्रमाण-प्रमोद, अस्, m., N.
of a Nyāya work by Hari.
—प्रमाण-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, constituting proof or authority; true, autho-
ritative; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva.
—प्रमाण-
माला or प्रमाण-रत्नमाला, f., N. of a Vedānta
work by Ānanda-bodha Yati.
—प्रमाण-लक्षण,
अम्, n., N. of a Vedānta work.
—प्रमाण-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, furnished with proofs, established by proofs,
well-founded.
—प्रमाण-वाक्य, अम्, n. authorita-
tive statement, authority.
—प्रमाण-वार्त्तिक, अम्,
n. and प्रमाण-विनिश्चय, अस्, m., N. of two
works by Dharma-kīrtti.
—प्रमाण-शास्त्र, अम्, n.
any work of sacred authority, scripture.
—प्रमाण-
समुच्चय, अस्, m., N. of a work by Diṅ-nāga.
—प्रमाण-सूत्र, अम्, n. a measuring cord.
—प्रमाणाधिक (˚ण-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, being
beyond measure, excessive, unnaturally strong.
—प्रमाणान्तर (˚ण-अन्˚), अम्, n. another means
of proof.
—प्रमाणान्तर-ता, f. the being another
means of proof.
—प्रमाणाभाव (˚ण-अभ्˚), अस्,
m. absence of proof, want of authority.
—प्रमाणी-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being an authority or proof,
proving, establishing.

प्रमाणक, अस्, इका, अम्, (at the end of a
comp.) = प्र-माण, measure, quantity, extent, cir-
cumference; (इका), f. a kind of metre, four times
˘¯˘¯˘¯˘¯.

प्रमाणय, Nom. P. प्रमाणयति, -यितुम्,
to make or regard as an authority upon any point
(with acc. of the person and loc. of the object); to
receive as an authority, admit or obey as an authority;
to hold up as a model; to prove, demonstrate, show
clearly, manifest.

प्रमाणयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, receiving or admit-
ting as an authority, obeying as authority.

प्रमाणिक, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. प्रमाणक above],
forming a measure or standard, being a measure,
forming an authority (perhaps a wrong reading for
प्रामाणिक, q. v.).

प्रामाणिक प्रामाणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
माण), forming or being a measure; established
by proof, resting or founded on an authority, pro-
ceeding from evidence or authority, being of authority,
authoritative; authentic, credible; true; (अस्), m.
one who accepts proof or rests his arguments on
authority; a president, the chief or head of a trade.
—प्रामाणिक-त्व, अम्, n. = प्रामाण्य below.

प्र-माणित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्रमाणय above),
proved, demonstrated, shown clearly.

प्रमाणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to mete out or apportion to (with gen.);
to take as a rule or authority, regard as an autho-
rity; to conform to, obey (with acc.); to regard as
proof; to prove.
—प्रमाणी-करण, अम्, n. esta-
blishing or admitting as authority, regarding as proof.
—प्रमाणी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, admitted or esta-
blished as proof, regarded as authority; conformed to.

प्र-मातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, knowing truly or well,
[]
having a right notion or idea, competent to judge;
any person who gives evidence or proof, an authority,
a proof; proving, demonstrating.

प्र-मापक, अस्, इका, अम्, affording proof or
certain knowledge, furnishing authority; (अस्), m.
an authority, an author cited or quoted.

1. प्र-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, meted out, measured;
known, understood; established by argument, demon-
strated, proved; measured off, limited, few, little;
(at the end of a comp.) measuring, of such and such
measure or extent, of such and such size.
—प्रमि-
ताक्षरा (˚त-अक्˚), f. ‘having measured syllables,’
a kind of metre, four times ˘˘¯˘¯˘˘˘¯˘˘¯.

2. प्र-मित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see above), Ved.
erected, built.

प्र-मीत, अस्, आ, अम्, dead, deceased; immo-
lated, sacrificed.
—प्रमीत-पतिक, आ, f. one whose
husband is dead, a widow.

प्र-मिति, इस्, f. measure, measuring, measurement;
a correct notion, right conception, true knowledge,
knowledge or information established by proof; true
inference or analogy.
प्र-मीति, इस्, f. ruin, destruction, death.

प्र-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be measured, measurable,
finite; to be fathomed or penetrated; admitting of
evidence or proof, to be proved, provable, demon-
strable; discernible; (अम्), n. an object of certain
knowledge; the thing to be proved, subject under
discussion, topic to be discussed or established.
—प्र-
मेय-कमल-मार्तण्ड, N. of a work.
—प्र-
मेय-त्व, अम्, n. provableness, capability of being
proved.
प्रमेय प्र-मेय. See p. 637, col. 3.
प्रमातव्य प्र-मातव्य. See p. 638, col. 1.
प्र-मातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be slain or killed.

प्रमातामह प्र-मातामह, अस्, m. a maternal
great-grandfather; (ई), f. a maternal great-grand-
mother.

प्रमात्र प्र-मात्र, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a particular high number.

प्रमापण प्र-मापण, &c. See p. 638,
col. 1.

प्र-मापण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus.), murder-
ing, murderous, a murderer; (अम्), n. killing, slay-
ing, slaughter; (sometimes also spelt प्र-मापन.)

प्रमार्जक प्र-मार्जक, &c. See under प्र-
मृज्, p. 638, col. 3.
प्र-मार्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, wiping off, removing.

प्रमी प्र-मी, cl. 9. P. A. -मीणाति, -मीणीते
(Ved. -मिनाति, -मिनीते), -मातुम्, to frustrate,
annul, destroy, annihilate; to diminish; to change,
alter; to neglect, transgress, infringe (Ved.); to
miss, lose (one's way), forget (Ved.); to cause to
disappear, put out of sight, leave behind, outstrip,
surmount, surpass; to come to naught, perish, die:
Caus. -मापयति, -यितुम्, to destroy, annihilate,
kill, slay.

प्रमिद् प्र-मिद्, cl. 1. A., 4. P. -मेदते,
-मेद्यति, -मेदितुम्, to begin to become fat; to
begin to show affection.

प्र-मेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, having begun to show
affection (according to a Scholiast = स्निग्धी-भवि-
तुम् आरब्धः); being or made unctuous, unctuous,
greasy.
—प्रमेदित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having be-
come unctuous, having been made unctuous.
प्रमेदित प्र-मेदित. See प्र-मिद्, p. 637.

प्रमिह् प्र-मिह्, cl. 1. P. -मेहति, -मेढुम्,
to make water, pass urine.

प्र-मीढ, अस्, आ, अम्, passed as urine; thick,
compact.
प्रमीढ प्र-मीढ. See प्र-मिह्, p. 637.

प्र-मेह, अस्, m. urinary disease (a general term
applied to all diseases characterized by a morbid con-
dition of the urine; twenty-one varieties are enume-
rated, including diabetes, gleet, gonorrhœa, &c.).

प्रमेह प्र-मेह, प्र-मेहिन्. See under
प्र-मिह्, p. 637, col. 3.

प्र-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from urinary
disease or affections.

प्र-मयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. liable to be lost or
destroyed, destructible, perishable.

प्र-मायु, उस्, उस्, उ, or प्र-मायुक, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. liable to ruin or destruction, perishable,
destructible, dying away.

प्र-मापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, causing to perish,
destructive, leading to ruin; a murderer.
—प्रमा-
पयितृ-त्व, अम्, n. destructiveness, murderousness.
प्र-मापित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, killed, slain.
प्र-मापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, destroying, killing, slaying.

प्र-मीणत्, अन्, अती, अत्, injuring, killing; over-
coming, subduing.

प्र-मीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be destroyed or killed,
destructible.

प्रमील् प्र-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -मीलितुम्,
to close or shut the eyes.

प्र-मीला, f. shutting the eyes, sleepiness, lassi-
tude, weariness, enervation, exhaustion from indo-
lence or fatigue.

प्र-मीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, closing the eyes, with
closed eyes.

प्र-मीलिन्, ई, m., N. of a demon (who causes
the eyes to close, or brings on faintness).

प्रमीव् प्र-मीव्, cl. 1. P. -मीवति, -मीवितुम्,
to push towards, press; to instigate, incite.
प्रमुक्ति प्र-मुक्ति. See प्र-मुच् below.

प्र-मुक्ति, इस्, f., Ved. setting free, liberation;
N. of particular sacred texts.

प्रमुख प्र-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, turning the
face towards (with acc.), facing; first, foremost,
chief, principal, most excellent; (at the end of a
comp.) having as chief, headed by, led by, preceded
by, accompanied with [cf. प्रीति-प्˚, वशिष्ठ-प्˚];
honourable, respectable; (अस्), m. a chief, respect-
able man, sage; a heap, multitude; a tree used in
dyeing, Rottleria Tinctoria; (अम्), n. the mouth;
commencement, beginning (of a chapter); time
being, the present, the same time; (ए), ind. before
the face of, in the presence of, in front of, before,
opposite to (with gen.); प्रमुखे कृ, to cause to
go before or precede.
—प्रमुख-तस्, ind. at the
head of, in front of, before the face of, before, oppo-
site to (with gen.); before all others, first, in the
first place.
—प्रमुख-ता, f. or प्रमुख-त्व,
अम्, n. superiority, predominance.
प्रमुग्ध प्र-मुग्ध. See प्र-मुह्, col. 2.

प्र-मुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fainting, unconscious;
very charming.

प्रमुच् प्र-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते,
-मोक्तुम्, to let loose, loosen, loose, untie, unbind,
undo; to set free, let go, liberate, release; to forsake,
desert, abandon; to give up, resign, renounce; to
shake off; to discharge, emit, throw out, vomit, shed;
to hurl, fling, cast, throw, shoot, send; to utter;
to throw or put on (as a garland &c.); to remove,
expel, drive away, banish: Pass. -मुच्यते, to be
loosened, become loose or detached; to leave off,
cease (with abl.); to free one's self from, rid one's
self of (with abl.): Caus. -मोचयति, -यितुम्, to
loosen, untie; to set free, liberate: Desid. -मुमु-
क्षति, to wish to give up, be about to resign.

प्र-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosened, untied; set
free, released, liberated; given up, resigned, re-
nounced; hurled, cast, shot.

प्र-मुच, अस्, or प्र-मुचु, उस्, m., N. of a
Ṛṣi.

प्र-मोक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be liberated, to be
set free.
प्रमोक्तव्य प्र-मोक्तव्य. See col. 1.

प्र-मोचन, अस्, ई, अम्, liberating, setting free;
(ई), f. a species of cucumber; (अम्), n. the act of
liberating, setting free; discharging, emitting, shed-
ding.
प्रमोचन प्र-मोचन. See col. 2.

प्रमुद् 1. प्र-मुद्, cl. 1. A. -मोदते, -मो-
दितुम्, to become joyful, rejoice greatly, exult, be
delighted: Caus. -मोदयति, -यितुम्, to make glad,
delight, exhilarate.

2. प्र-मुद्, त्, त्, त्, pleased, happy; (त्), f., Ved.
gladness, delight, pleasure; sensual pleasure.

प्र-मुदित, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted, pleased, happy,
glad, content; (आ), f. (with Buddhists) N. of one of
the ten Bhūmis; (अम्), n. epithet of one of the
eight perfections in the Sāṅkhya philosophy.
—प्र-
मुदित-प्रलम्ब-सुनयन, अस्, m., N. of a
Gandharva-rāja.
—प्रमुदित-वदना, f., N. of a
metre, four times ˘˘˘˘˘˘¯, ˘¯¯˘¯.
—प्र-
मुदित-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, having the heart de-
lighted, delighted in heart.

प्र-मोद, अस्, m. excessive joy, delight, pleasure,
gladness, happiness; one of the eight perfections in
the Sāṅkhya philosophy; Pleasure personified as a
child of Brahmā; a strong perfume; N. of a being
attendant upon Skanda; of a Nāga; of a man; of
the fourth year in a sixty years’ cycle of Jupiter.
—प्रमोद-नृत्य, अम्, n. joyous dancing, a
joyful dance.

प्रमोद प्र-मोद, &c. See under 1. प्र-
मुद्, col. 2.

प्र-मोदक, अस्, m. a kind of grain (= षष्-
टिका).

प्रामोदक प्रामोदक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
मोद), charming, transporting, enchanting.

प्र-मोदन, अस्, ई, अम्, making glad, gladdening,
exhilarating; an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. making
glad, gladdening; gladness, joyousness.

प्र-मोदमान, अम्, n. ‘rejoicing,’ epithet of
one of the eight perfections in the Sāṅkhya phi-
losophy.

प्र-मोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted, rejoiced,
pleased, happy; (अस्), m. an epithet of Kuvera;
(अम्), n. epithet of one of the eight perfections in
the Sāṅkhya philosophy; [cf. प्र-मोदमान
above.]

प्रमोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing excessive joy, de-
lighting, making happy, gladdening; delighted,
happy; (इनी), f., N. of a plant (= जिङ्गिनी).

प्रमुर्छ् प्र-मुर्छ्, cl. 1. P. -मूर्छति, -मूर्-
छितुम्, Ved. to become thick or solid, congeal.

प्रमुष् प्र-मुष्, cl. 9. P. -मुष्णाति, -मो-
षितुम्, to steal away, carry off, rob, pilfer.

प्र-मुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, stolen away, carried
off; distracted, beside one's self; (आ), f. a kind of
riddle.

प्रमुह् प्र-मुह्, cl. 4. P. -मुह्यति, -मोग्-
धुम्, -मोढुम्, to become bewildered or infatu-
ated; to faint, swoon: Caus. -मोहयति, -यितुम्,
to bewilder, infatuate.

प्र-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, infatuated,
deceived; foolish, stupid, a fool.
—प्रमूढ-
सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind perplexed,
bewildered, infatuated.

प्र-मोह, अस्, m. bewilderment, infatuation, fas-
cination; insensibility, stupefaction, stupor, fainting
away.
—प्रमोह-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered in
mind.
प्रमोह प्र-मोह, &c. See प्र-मुह्, col. 2.
प्र-मोहन, अस्, ई, अम्, infatuating the mind.
प्र-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, infatuated.
प्रमोहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bewildering, infatuating.
प्रमूर प्र-मूर in अ-प्रमूर, q. v.

प्रमृ प्र-मृ, Caus. P. -मारयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to put to death.

प्रमॄ प्र-मॄ, cl. 9. P. -मृणाति, &c., Ved.
to crush, destroy; [cf. प्र-मृण्.]
प्र-मरण, अम्, n., Ved. dying, death.
प्रमृत प्र-मृत, &c. See प्र-मृ, col. 2.
प्रमृतक, अस्, आ, अम्, dead.

प्रमृगम् प्र-मृगम्, ind., see Gaṇa Tish-
ṭhadgv-ādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 17.

प्र-मृग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought or searched
after; peculiarly adapted to or fitted for (with dat.).

प्र-मार्जन, अम्, n. the act of rubbing off,
wiping off; अश्रु-प्रमार्जन, the wiping away or
drying of tears, consoling.

प्र-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, washed or rubbed off;
rubbed; polished, bright, clear.

प्रमृण् प्र-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c.,
Ved. to crush, destroy.
प्र-मृण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. destroying, crushing.

प्रमृद् प्र-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्-
दितुम्, to crush down, destroy, lay waste, ravage,
devastate.

प्र-मर्दन, अस्, ई, अम्, crushing down, crush-
ing, destroying; rubbing out or away; (अस्), m. an
epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of an attendant of Śiva; of a
Vidyā-dhara; of a general of Śambara; (अम्), n.
crushing, destroying.

प्र-मर्दितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who crushes or
destroys, a destroyer.
प्र-मर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, destroying, crushing.

प्रमृश् प्र-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, -मर्ष्-
टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, Ved. to lay hold of, handle;
(according to Mahī-dhara) to reflect, consider, de-
liberate.

प्रमृष् प्र-मृष्, cl. 4. and 1. P. A. -मृष्-
यति, -ते, -मर्षति, -ते, -मर्षितुम्, Ved. to
forget, neglect; (Sāy.) to destroy.

प्र-मृश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. laying hold of, hand-
ling; (according to Mahī-dhara) = पण्डित.
प्र-मृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, in अ-प्˚, q. v.

प्रमोक्ष प्र-मोक्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. मोक्ष्
with प्र), letting fall, dropping, losing; discharging,
dismissing, liberation.

प्र-मोक्षण, अम्, n. ‘releasing,’ a term applied
to the end of an eclipse.

प्रमोत प्र-मोत (perhaps fr. rt. मीव्), Ved.
a particular kind of disease.

प्रम्रद् प्र-म्रद् [cf. प्र-मृद्], cl. 1. A.
-म्रदते, -म्रदितुम्, Ved. to destroy, kill.

प्रम्लुच् प्र-म्लुच्, cl. 1. P. -म्लोचति, -म्लो-
चितुम्, Ved. to go down, sink down.

प्र-म्लोचन्ती or प्र-म्लोचा, f., N. of an Apsaras
or nymph of heaven.

प्रम्लै प्र-म्लै, cl. 1. P. -म्लायति, -म्लातुम्,
to fade away, become faded, wither away, wither.

प्र-म्लान, अस्, आ, अम्, faded away, withered
[]
away, faded, withered; soiled, dirty.
—प्रम्लान-
वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, having the face dried up or
soiled (with weeping &c.).
—प्रम्लान-शरीर, अस्,
आ, अम्, withered in body, having an exhausted frame.

प्रामाण्य, अम्, n. the being established by proof,
the resting upon authority; the being an authority;
the being a rule, the being a proof; proof, evidence,
authority; authenticity, credibility, genuineness (=
प्रमाण-ता).
—प्रामाण्य-वाद, अस्, m., N. of a
Nyāya work by Raghu-nātha.
—प्रामाण्य-वादिन्,
ई, m. one who affirms or believes in proof.
प्रामीत्य प्रामीत्य, अम्, n. debt.

प्रमाण-कोटि, इस्, f. the point in an argument
which is regarded as actual proof.

प्र-मृड, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. मृड् with प्र),
favourable, gracious.

प्र-मोष, अस्, m. carrying off, plundering,
robbery.
